notes: Main four-track interactions used the normal-profile real LRECA+SEG case B. D/E and synthetic rendering tests used only the explicit test environment.

The browser connection ended during test-tab cleanup. Completed observations were preserved. The in-app browser then rechecked LRECA-only and SEG-only session reset and displayed the final real combined result.
The first/last marker pixel check used the original 1848px content viewport before the prescribed 1440/1280/1024 responsive checks.
Feature timings use very small samples and measure application commit or synchronous Canvas execution, not screen paint or scientific inference.
No data were read from private browser internals or injected into application state.
